images.title: Slide the top, keep the area
images.purpose: Shows the triangle slider in its simplest state: one triangle on base BC with its top A free to slide along a parallel line, area fixed at 12 cm².
images.composition: One triangle, large and centred, under a long parallel line, with a two headed arrow at A along the line.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. A horizontal segment BC 6 units long, B on the left, C on the right. A long thin dark horizontal line l, 4 units above BC, running well past both ends. One triangle ABC with A on l, 1 unit to the right of the point above B, filled teal (#0072B2). A reddish purple (#CC79A7) two headed arrow lying along l through A, about 6 units long. A grey (#6B7280) dashed vertical height from A down to BC with a small right angle mark. Labels: A, B, C at those points; l at the right end of the line; 6 cm under BC; 4 cm beside the dashed height; 12 cm² inside the triangle. Check: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Wherever A slides on l, the height stays 4 cm, so the area stays 12 cm².

image_decisions.why: Shows the tool's one move, sliding A along l, with the fixed height that keeps the area constant.
